MathJax 3.2.2, pinned from the official npm `mathjax` package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/mathjax/-/mathjax-3.2.2.tgz

This directory contains the `mml-chtml.js` combined component and its 23 TeX WOFF fonts, copied without modification from `es5/output/chtml/fonts/woff-v2/`. The runtime uses the bundled Apache 2.0 license. The fonts use the SIL Open Font License in `fonts/LICENSE.txt`, which also preserves their copyright and reserved-name notices. It typesets the blog posts' MathML using MathJax's classic TeX font metrics; no CDN is needed at viewing time.
